expectations.text: Uses a single top-level `issues` array to carry the failures
expectations.evidence: Uses a `{ "error": { code, message, details, request_id } }` envelope — single error object, not an issues array.

expectations.text: Issue codes are descriptive, lowercase, namespaced `{type}.{detail}` strings (not numeric or SCREAMING_SNAKE)
expectations.evidence: Codes are SCREAMING_SNAKE and not namespaced: `BANK_TOKEN_EXPIRED`, `PAYOUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `PROVIDER_REJECTED`.
No `type` or `severity` fields; uses `code` and `request_id` instead.

expectations.text: Sequra's rejection is surfaced via a `thirdParty` passthrough object
expectations.evidence: Vendor data placed under `details.provider*`, not a `thirdParty` object.

expectations.text: Covers all three failure modes with distinct, descriptive codes
expectations.evidence: All three cases modelled with distinct codes and good rationale.
